findings.message: This process group defines variable 'host' and already uses parameter context 'Fixture Context', which resolves a parameter of the same name. Adding the variable as a parameter would change what #{host} means for every group using that context, so flowport leaves this group's variables unchanged.
findings.suggestion: Rename the variable or the parameter, or drop the variable if the parameter value is the intended one, then run the migration again.
findings.title: Variable name collides with an existing parameter

findings.message: This process group defines 2 variable(s): host, retries. NiFi 2.x removed the Variable Registry and silently drops them when the flow loads.
findings.suggestion: Convert the variables to a parameter context (flowport migrate variables) and rewrite the references to #{name}.
findings.title: Process group defines variables

findings.message: Property 'Base Path' references variable ${host} (defined in /Existing Context). On NiFi 2.x the variable no longer exists, so the expression evaluates to empty unless a FlowFile attribute or environment variable of the same name exists. No validation error will point at this.
findings.suggestion: Replace the reference with a parameter: #{host}.
findings.title: Property references a variable
